outcome: Immediate postoperative ability to walk (neurological deterioration)
Improvement in walking ability by 3 to 5 weeks postoperatively
cohort: Fifty-seven dogs with single focal spinal intra-arachnoid diverticula were included in this multi-centre study.
finding: The study found no overall influence of surgical technique on short-term outcomes, though dogs undergoing shunt placement specifically showed immediate neurological deterioration that improved within 3-5 weeks.
followup_time: 24 hours postsurgery and 3 to 5 weeks postoperatively
